EVENTSENTRY_HOST.description: EventSentry Web Reports base URL, e.g. https://eventsentry.example.com:8844 — no trailing path.

EVENTSENTRY_API_KEY.description: API token (JWT) minted from the EventSentry admin UI under user API keys. Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' by default; flip to a different header via EVENTSENTRY_HEADER_NAME / EVENTSENTRY_HEADER_PREFIX.

EVENTSENTRY_EVENTS_PATH.description: JSON endpoint to query. Default '/events/json'. Every UI list page exposes a /<page>/json sibling — set this to '/logons/json', '/diskspacestatus/json', '/arpstatus/json', '/adchanges/json', '/auditpolicy/json', '/filechecksumstatus/json', etc. to ingest other data types.

EVENTSENTRY_HEADER_NAME.description: HTTP header that carries the token. Default 'Authorization' (paired with EVENTSENTRY_HEADER_PREFIX='Bearer ').

EVENTSENTRY_HEADER_PREFIX.description: String prepended to the token value. Default 'Bearer '. Set to '' (empty) if EVENTSENTRY_HEADER_NAME is e.g. 'X-API-Key'.

EVENTSENTRY_DATE_RANGE.description: EventSentry date-range preset, used verbatim as the 'search.dateRange' query param. Examples: 'Today', 'Last 24 hours' (default if not set), 'Last 7 days', 'Last 30 days', 'Last 90 days'. Overrides EVENTSENTRY_DAYS_BACK.

EVENTSENTRY_DAYS_BACK.description: Convenience: bucket the lookback into the nearest EventSentry preset (0='Today', 1='Last 24 hours', 7='Last 7 days', 30='Last 30 days', 90='Last 90 days'). Default 1. Ignored when EVENTSENTRY_DATE_RANGE is set.

EVENTSENTRY_SEARCH_QUERY.description: Raw EventSentry filter expression forwarded as 'search.query'. Examples: 'computer:WEB01', 'admin:Yes', 'source:Service Control Manager'.

EVENTSENTRY_SOURCE_FILTER.description: Shortcut for 'search.query=computer:<value>'. Ignored if EVENTSENTRY_SEARCH_QUERY is set.

EVENTSENTRY_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Client-side severity floor. Valid: critical | error | warning | information | audit_failure | audit_success (EventSentry buckets) OR info | low | medium | high | critical (Faraday buckets). Default: medium ('warning').

EVENTSENTRY_MAX_PAGES.description: Hard cap on pages fetched per scan. Default 50 (= 25k rows at the default page size).

name: eventsentry
title: EventSentry
description: EventSentry SIEM / log-management import. Talks to EventSentry Web Reports (v6.x) via its UI-backing JSON endpoints (default /events/json — every list page has a /<page>/json sibling: logons, diskspacestatus, arpstatus, adchanges, auditpolicy, filechecksumstatus, etc.). Auth: API token (JWT) minted from the admin UI, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Filters use EventSentry's own search DSL (search.dateRange + search.query, e.g. 'computer:WEB01' or 'admin:Yes'). Each distinct 'computer' becomes one Faraday host (synthetic 0.0.0.0; hostname = computer name); each row above the severity floor becomes one Faraday vulnerability tagged '[SIEM]'. Severity is normalised from EventSentry's enum (Critical / Error / Warning / Information / Audit Success / Audit Failure) into Faraday's five-bucket scheme; CVE refs are harvested from the message, and EventSentry-EventID / EventSentry-Source / EventSentry-Log refs are added for cross-pivot. Pagination via search.page + search.limit; backs off 30s on HTTP 429.
